extension.news: 1.0.0[CR]- Fork of Arctic: Zephyr - Reloaded 3.0.3 (beatmasterRS), renamed skin.arctic.worms[CR]- Storage info shows the data partition when service.worms.diskinfo is installed (CoreELEC/LibreELEC: /storage instead of the read-only system image)[CR]- Add-on windows: default skin font and colour names, plain colour textures[CR]- Built-in ProtonVPN home widget (service.protonvpn.manager)[CR]- Wtube (plugin.video.wtube) supported next to YouTube[CR]- Bug fixes from the 3.0.4 audit (dialogs, textures, fonts, escaping)[CR]Full history: changelog.txt
